desc: Derive conditions: R=0→B even & B≥4; B=0→R even & R≥4; R=1,B=1→No; R=1,B≥2→No; R≥2,B=1→Yes; R≥2,B≥2→Yes.
Construct placements for pure red (B=0, R even ≥4): rectangular cycle.
Construct placements for pure blue (R=0, B even ≥4): diamond cycle using diagonal moves.
Construct placements for mixed cases (R≥2,B≥1): use a pattern with reds in a vertical/horizontal line and blues in a diagonal, connecting properly.
Verify constructions for small cases (R=2,B=1; R=2,B=2; R=2,B=3; R=4,B=0; R=0,B=4) by checking adjacency and cycle closure.
Implement the C++17 program: handle up to 2e5 total pieces, read T, process each case, output "Yes"/"No" and the placement lines.
Test with sample input and additional edge cases.
